problem: The R12 ELLIPSE tessellator classified any distinct start/end parameters within 1e-10 as a complete closed ellipse; it also closed shorter-than-full sweeps within 1e-10 of one turn. For center (2,3,0), major axis (1e8,0,0), ratio .5, and start/end .5 and .5+5e-11, the old code emitted 128 closed vertices around the entire ellipse instead of the short arc's two end vertices. The opted-in R12 CCW wrap had the same tolerance-band behavior.

authority.dxfScope: The ELLIPSE group-41/42 parameters for a full ellipse are 0 and 2pi.
authority.objectArxScope: A full elliptical arc has a two-pi parameter span. Exact equal-parameter full behavior remains a libdxfrw legacy convention, not a new claim about Autodesk input semantics.

change: Keep the established exact-equal and exact representable plus/minus one-turn full ellipse cases. Distinct smaller spans are open, and spans greater than one turn refuse output unless endpoint addition corresponds exactly to a representable full turn. The optional wrapped-CCW writer maps any distinct canonical wrapped endpoint except the exact reverse full turn; legacy signed direction remains the default. Endpoint comparison also preserves one-turn inputs represented as start plus or minus 2pi when subtraction rounds.

validation.generatedControls: Direct API and ASCII/Binary R12 output, default and opt-in direction, 2D XY and tilted 3D WCS; short positive/negative arcs, near-full open arcs, near-wrapped CCW, exact equal and +/- full turns. Check entity type, flags, vertex counts, open endpoints against ellipse equations, caller parameters and readback with extrusion both disabled and enabled. Invalid extrusion and greater-than-one-turn paths preserve destination sentinel and accept corrected same-writer retry. Existing ordinary wrap, legacy direction, HATCH edge and CLI carrier controls pass.
validation.negativeControl: Compiled the pre-change drw_entities.cpp and libdxfrw.cpp from commit 93121b09 into a scratch-only static archive and linked the new test; it fails the short positive arc control as expected. The changed build passes.
validation.fixtures: All files are locally generated under temporary paths and removed; no fixture was added.

limits: R12 approximates curves with straight segments; these checks are not native CAD rendering evidence. This slice does not redefine legacy equal-parameter semantics, validate every alternate parameter normalization or address tiny out-of-plane tolerance in the 2D/3D classifier. Broader 2D/3D consumer and platform qualification remains open.
